children.value: 🏦 🆔 Series IDs for constant maturity yields and the secured overnight funding rate SOFR

children.label: 🏦 🆔 Series IDs for constant maturity yields and the secured overnight funding rate SOFR

children.value: Generate a potential list of Series IDs for constant maturity yields as
: all monthly maturities between one and eleven months
: all years between one and thirty years
Secured overnight Id is ‘SOFR’.  The list of all IDs is series_id.

# Generate months 1-11 and years 1-30 programmatically
monthly_ids = [f"DGS{i}MO" for i in range(1, 12)]
yearly_ids = [f"DGS{i}" for i in range(1, 31)]

# Combine everything together with SOFR
series_ids = ['sofr'] + monthly_ids + yearly_ids
🔗 Accessing constant maturity yields for May 2026 with

children.value: Create an instance of the FredRreder
is required and be a string or an iterable of strings.
time for cache to live defaults to 7 days.

# create an instance of FredReader
fred_data=fq.FredReader()

# call the method for the class
yield_data=fred_data.get_series(series_ids,start_date='2026-05-01')
